title: Ansel and the Parish
author: Cyrus Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Amberdale, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
